stem.en:

• A class collected old newspapers for recycling.
• In October, the class collected 30 kilograms.
• In November, the class collected 60 kilograms.
• The newspapers were kept in the school storeroom until a truck took them away.

The student wants to compare the amounts collected in the two months.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The class collected 60 kilograms of newspapers in November, twice the 30 kilograms it collected in October.
In November, the class collected 60 kilograms of old newspapers for recycling.
The class collected old newspapers for recycling in October and in November.
In October, the class collected 30 kilograms of old newspapers.

why.en: A comparison by numbers needs both months and their relation: 60 kilograms is twice 30. The other choices give one month or no number.
why.uz: Sonlar bilan solishtirish uchun ikkala oy va nisbat kerak: 60 kilogramm 30 ning ikki baravari. Qolganlarida bitta oy yoki son yoʻq.
why.ru: Для сравнения нужны оба месяца и их соотношение: 60 килограммов — вдвое больше 30. В остальных один месяц или нет чисел.

Diyor, who learned in a lake near his village, can now swim 200 meters without stopping.

• Kumush and Rahim are neighbours who planted tulip bulbs in their front gardens in autumn.
• Kumush planted 45 bulbs.
• Rahim planted 15 bulbs.
• In spring, almost all of the bulbs flowered.

The student wants to compare the number of bulbs the two neighbours planted.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

Kumush planted 45 tulip bulbs, twice as many as the 15 that Rahim planted.
In autumn, the two neighbours planted tulip bulbs, and almost all of them flowered in spring.
Rahim planted 15 tulip bulbs in his front garden in autumn.

why.en: 45 is three times 15, so 'three times as many' is the right relation. 'Twice as many' names both numbers but gets the relation wrong.
why.uz: 45 soni 15 ning uch baravari, demak «three times as many» toʻgʻri nisbat. «Twice as many» ikkala sonni aytadi, lekin nisbat xato.
why.ru: 45 — это втрое больше 15, значит, верно «three times as many». «Twice as many» называет оба числа, но соотношение неверно.

• Mahbuba bakes only on Fridays and Sundays.
• Saodat sells her bread to the neighbours.
• Mahbuba gives hers to her children and grandchildren.

Saodat bakes every morning before sunrise, whereas Mahbuba bakes only on Fridays and Sundays.
Saodat sells her bread to the neighbours, but Mahbuba gives hers to her family.
Mahbuba, who learned to bake from her own mother, bakes bread in a clay oven in her yard on Fridays and Sundays.

The club sold 64 pots of herbs on Saturday, half as many as the 32 it sold on Sunday.

• Two pupils built model houses for a design class.
• Madina built hers from cardboard boxes.
• Rustam built his from old wooden ice-cream sticks.
• Madina's house took 3 evenings to build.
• Rustam's house took 9 evenings to build.
• Both houses had a door that opened and a roof that lifted off.
• The teacher gave both houses top marks.

The student wants to emphasize a difference in how long the two houses took to build.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Rustam spent 9 evenings building his model house, three times as long as the 3 evenings Madina needed.
Madina built her model house from cardboard boxes, while Rustam used old wooden ice-cream sticks.
Both model houses had a door that opened and a roof that lifted off, and both got top marks.
Rustam spent 9 evenings building his model house, three times as long as any other pupil in the whole class.

why.ru: Цель — время: 9 вечеров втрое больше 3 вечеров Мадины. Материал — другое различие, а «any other pupil» нет в заметках.

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Two classes took part in the school sports day.
• Class 9A won 4 races and lost 2.
• Class 9B won 4 races and lost 5.
• Class 9A wore green shirts; Class 9B wore yellow.
• Each class won exactly one relay.

The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the results of the two classes.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Class 9A and Class 9B each won 4 races, and each also won exactly one relay.
Class 9A lost only 2 races, while Class 9B lost 5.
Class 9A, in green shirts, won 4 races and one relay at the sports day.
Both classes took part in the sports day, Class 9A in green shirts and Class 9B in yellow.

why.en: The goal is a similarity in results: each class won 4 races and one relay. The losses differ, and shirts are not results.
why.uz: Maqsad natijadagi oʻxshashlik: har bir sinf 4 ta poygada va bitta estafetada gʻolib. Magʻlubiyatlar har xil, futbolka natija emas.
why.ru: Цель — сходство в результатах: каждый класс выиграл 4 забега и одну эстафету. Поражения разные, футболки — не результат.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The school garden club grows tomatoes and peppers.
• The club waters the plants at 6 p.m.
• At midday the sun is very strong.
• Water given at midday dries up before it reaches the roots.

The student wants to explain why the club waters its plants in the evening.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The club waters at 6 p.m. because water given in the strong midday sun dries up before it reaches the roots.
The school garden club grows tomatoes and peppers and waters them at 6 p.m.
At midday, the sun over the school garden is very strong.
The garden club grows tomatoes and peppers in the school garden.

why.en: An explanation needs the reason with 'because': midday water dries up before reaching the roots. The others say what or when.
why.uz: Tushuntirish uchun «because» bilan sabab kerak: tushda berilgan suv ildizga yetmay qurib qoladi. Qolganlari nima yoki qachonni aytadi.
why.ru: Для объяснения нужна причина с «because»: дневная вода высыхает, не дойдя до корней. Остальные говорят что или когда.

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Class 7C wanted to waste less food in the school canteen.
• For two weeks, they weighed the food left on plates after lunch.
• Then they asked the cooks to serve smaller portions, with seconds for anyone still hungry.
• Two weeks later, the food left on plates had fallen by half.

The student wants to present the result of the class project.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: After the cooks served smaller portions, the food left on plates fell by half.
For two weeks, Class 7C weighed the food left on plates after lunch.
Class 7C wanted to waste less food in the school canteen.
The class asked the cooks to serve smaller portions, with seconds for anyone still hungry.

why.en: A result is what happened in the end: the food left on plates fell by half. The other choices give the aim or the steps.
why.uz: Natija — oxirida nima boʻlgani: likopchalarda qolgan ovqat yarmiga kamaydi. Qolganlari maqsad yoki qadamlarni aytadi.
why.ru: Результат — то, что вышло в конце: остатков еды стало вдвое меньше. Другие варианты дают цель или шаги.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Bahrom wanted to find out which window in his flat got the most sun.
• He put the same kind of thermometer on each of three windowsills.
• He read all three thermometers at 9 a.m., 12 p.m. and 3 p.m. for one week.
• The kitchen window was the warmest at every reading.

The student wants to describe the method Bahrom used.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Bahrom put the same kind of thermometer on three windowsills and read each one at 9 a.m., noon and 3 p.m. for a week.
The kitchen window was the warmest of the three windows in Bahrom's flat at every single reading that he took that week.
Bahrom wanted to know which window in his flat got the most sun.
Bahrom found that the kitchen window got more sun than the other two.

why.en: A method is how it was done: the same thermometers on three sills, read three times a day for a week. The others give the aim or the result.
why.uz: Usul — qanday qilingani: uchta deraza tokchasida bir xil termometr, bir hafta kuniga uch marta. Qolganlari maqsad yoki natija.
why.ru: Способ — как это делали: одинаковые термометры на трёх подоконниках, три раза в день неделю. Остальные — цель или результат.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The swap shelf is a bookshelf in the entrance of Block 7 in the mahalla.
• Neighbours leave books, toys and jars they no longer need.
• Anyone can take what they like, free of charge.
• A retired teacher who lives in the block started it two years ago.
• The most popular things are picture books for children.

The student wants to introduce the swap shelf to readers who do not know about it.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The swap shelf in Block 7 is a bookshelf where neighbours leave things they no longer need, free for anyone to take.
Picture books for children are the most popular things on the swap shelf.
A retired teacher who lives in Block 7 started the swap shelf two years ago.
Since a retired teacher started it two years ago, the swap shelf has become very popular with the neighbours in Block 7.

why.en: Readers new to it need to know what the shelf is and how it works. The others give a detail, or a claim the notes never make.
why.uz: Uni bilmaydigan oʻquvchiga javon nima ekani va qanday ishlashi kerak. Qolganlari tafsilot yoki qaydlarda yoʻq daʼvo.
why.ru: Тем, кто о ней не слышал, нужно знать, что это за полка и как она работает. Остальные — деталь или утверждение не из заметок.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Dilnoza's grandfather keeps his melons fresh until the New Year.
• His storeroom is under the house.
• He hangs each melon in a net bag from the ceiling of the cool, dark storeroom.
• The melons do not touch each other or the floor.

The student wants to explain how Dilnoza's grandfather keeps his melons fresh for so long.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: He hangs each melon in its own net bag from the ceiling of a cool, dark storeroom, so the melons touch nothing.
Every year, Dilnoza's grandfather keeps his melons fresh until the New Year.
His storeroom, which is under the house, is cool and dark.
The melons that Dilnoza's grandfather grows are the sweetest in the mahalla.

why.en: 'How' needs the way: each melon hangs in a net bag in a cool, dark room, touching nothing. The rest state facts without the way.
why.uz: «How» usulni talab qiladi: har bir qovun salqin, qorongʻi xonada toʻrda osilib, hech narsaga tegmaydi. Qolganlarida usul yoʻq.
why.ru: «How» требует способа: каждая дыня висит в сетке в прохладной тёмной комнате и ничего не касается. В остальных способа нет.

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Ruxshona asked the 28 pupils in her class how they get to school.
• 16 of them walk.
• 8 of them come by bus.
• 4 of them are driven by a parent.
• She asked her questions on a Monday morning.

The student wants to present Ruxshona's main finding.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: More than half of the 28 pupils in Ruxshona's class, 16 of them, walk to school.
Ruxshona asked the 28 pupils in her class, on a Monday morning, how they get to school.
In Ruxshona's class, 4 pupils are driven to school by a parent.
Ruxshona wanted to find out how her classmates get to school.

why.en: The main finding is the biggest result: 16 of 28, more than half, walk. Being driven is a minor detail, and the rest is the method.
why.uz: Asosiy topilma — eng katta natija: 28 tadan 16 tasi, yarmidan koʻpi piyoda keladi. Qolganlari mayda tafsilot yoki usul.
why.ru: Главный вывод — самый крупный результат: 16 из 28, больше половины, ходят пешком. Остальное — мелкая деталь или способ.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The mahalla library is open from Tuesday to Sunday.
• It has 3,000 books in Uzbek, Russian and English.
• Children under 12 can borrow books for free.
• Adults pay a small fee each year.
• It has a reading room with eight tables.

The student wants to emphasize what the library offers young children.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Children under 12 can borrow books from the mahalla library for free.
The mahalla library, open from Tuesday to Sunday, has 3,000 books in three languages and a reading room.
Adults pay a small yearly fee to borrow books from the mahalla library.
The library has 3,000 books in Uzbek, Russian and English.

why.en: The goal is one aspect, what young children get: free borrowing under 12. An overview of the whole library blurs that point.
why.uz: Maqsad bitta jihat — kichik bolalar nima oladi: 12 yoshgacha bepul kitob. Butun kutubxona haqidagi umumiy gap bu fikrni xiralashtiradi.
why.ru: Цель — один аспект, что получают маленькие дети: бесплатные книги до 12 лет. Обзор всей библиотеки размывает эту мысль.

instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Every autumn, Iroda and her mother make apple jam.
• First, they wash and cut 3 kilograms of apples.
• Next, they cook the apples with sugar for one hour.
• Finally, they pour the hot jam into clean jars.
• The family eats the jam all winter.

The student wants to describe the steps Iroda and her mother follow to make the jam.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Iroda and her mother wash and cut the apples, cook them with sugar for an hour, and then pour the hot jam into clean jars.
Every autumn, Iroda and her mother make apple jam that the family eats all winter.
Iroda and her mother cook 3 kilograms of apples with sugar for one hour.
The apple jam that Iroda and her mother make lasts the family the whole winter.

why.en: Steps need the order of the work: wash and cut, cook, pour into jars. One choice gives only one step; the others say what or how long it lasts.
why.uz: Qadamlar ish tartibini talab qiladi: yuvish va kesish, pishirish, bankalarga quyish. Bir javobda bitta qadam bor, xolos.
why.ru: Шаги требуют порядка работы: помыть и нарезать, сварить, разлить по банкам. В одном варианте только один шаг.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The school moved its football matches from Saturday to Friday afternoon.
• Many pupils go to their grandparents in the villages on Saturdays.
• Last year, teams often could not find eleven players on a Saturday.
• This year, every match has had full teams.

The student wants to explain why the school moved its football matches.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The school moved its matches to Friday because many pupils visit their grandparents on Saturdays, which left teams without eleven players.
Since the matches moved to Friday afternoon, every match has had full teams.
The school now holds its football matches on Friday afternoon instead of on Saturday, and so far this year every match has had full teams.
Many pupils at the school go to their grandparents in the villages on Saturdays.

why.en: 'Why' needs the reason linked to the change: Saturday visits left teams short, so matches moved. Full teams this year is the result.
why.uz: «Why» oʻzgarishga bogʻlangan sababni talab qiladi: shanbadagi safarlar jamoalarni kamaytirgan. Bu yilgi toʻliq jamoalar — natija.
why.ru: «Why» требует причины, связанной с переменой: субботние поездки оставляли команды без игроков. Полные команды — результат.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A class of 30 pupils tested whether music helps them remember words.
• Half the class learned 20 new English words in silence.
• The other half learned the same words with quiet music playing.
• The next day, both groups remembered about 14 words on average.

The student wants to present the result of the test.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The next day, the pupils who learned with music and those who learned in silence both remembered about 14 of the 20 words.
Half the class learned 20 new English words in silence, and the other half learned the same words with quiet music playing.
A class of 30 pupils tested whether music helps them remember new words.
The test showed that quiet music helps pupils remember new English words.

why.en: The result is what the test showed: both groups remembered about 14 words. One choice claims music helped, which the notes do not show.
why.uz: Natija — test nimani koʻrsatgani: ikkala guruh ham 14 tacha soʻz esladi. Bir javob musiqa yordam berdi deydi, qaydlar buni koʻrsatmaydi.
why.ru: Результат — что показал опыт: обе группы запомнили около 14 слов. Один вариант утверждает, что музыка помогла, а заметки этого не показывают.

instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The Saturday Fixers is a group of pupils at a school in the mahalla.
• Every Saturday morning, members repair broken things that neighbours bring in.
• They mend chairs, lamps, radios and bicycles.
• They charge nothing, but ask each neighbour to watch and learn.
• Last month they repaired 37 items.
• The group was started by two pupils in Grade 10.

The student wants to introduce the Saturday Fixers to an audience unfamiliar with the group.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The Saturday Fixers is a group of pupils who, every Saturday morning, repair the broken things neighbours bring in, free of charge.
Last month, the Saturday Fixers repaired 37 items, from chairs and lamps to radios and bicycles.
The Saturday Fixers charge nothing, but they ask each neighbour to watch and learn.
Two pupils in Grade 10 started the Saturday Fixers.

why.en: An unfamiliar audience first needs what the group is and does: pupils who repair neighbours' things each Saturday, for free.
why.uz: Guruhni bilmaydigan auditoriyaga avval u nima va nima qilishi kerak: har shanba qoʻshnilar buyumini bepul taʼmirlaydigan oʻquvchilar.
why.ru: Незнакомой аудитории сначала нужно знать, что это за группа и что она делает: ученики бесплатно чинят вещи соседей по субботам.

instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Last winter, the heating in the old school gym often failed.
• The caretaker, Ilhom, wanted to keep the gym warm without new heaters.
• He sealed the gaps around the windows with strips of felt.
• He hung thick curtains over the two doors to the yard.
• After these changes, the gym stayed 4 degrees warmer on cold mornings.
• Ilhom spent less than a day on the work.

The student wants to explain how Ilhom kept the gym warmer.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Ilhom kept the gym warmer by sealing the gaps around its windows with felt and hanging thick curtains over the doors to the yard.
After the changes Ilhom made, the old school gym stayed 4 degrees warmer on cold mornings.
The caretaker, Ilhom, wanted to keep the gym warm without buying new heaters.
Ilhom spent less than a day making the old school gym warmer.

why.en: 'How' asks for the way: felt in the window gaps and curtains over the doors, with 'by'. Four degrees warmer is the result, not the way.
why.uz: «How» usulni soʻraydi: deraza tirqishlariga kigiz va eshiklarga qalin parda, «by» bilan. Toʻrt daraja issiqroq — natija, usul emas.
why.ru: «How» спрашивает о способе: войлок в щелях окон и шторы на дверях, со словом «by». На 4 градуса теплее — результат.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Members of the school science club counted birds at the feeder in the yard.
• They counted for 15 minutes each morning for four weeks.
• In the first two weeks, the feeder held only bread.
• In the last two weeks, it held sunflower seeds.
• They counted about 6 birds a morning with bread and about 15 with seeds.

The student wants to present the club's finding.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The club counted more than twice as many birds a morning when the feeder held sunflower seeds, about 15, as when it held bread, about 6.
For four weeks, club members counted the birds at the feeder for 15 minutes each morning.
The club found that birds will eat only sunflower seeds.
Pupils in the science club put bread in the feeder in the first two weeks and seeds in the last two.

why.en: A finding is what the counts showed: about 15 birds with seeds, more than twice the 6 with bread. 'Only sunflower seeds' goes beyond the notes.
why.uz: Topilma — sanoq nimani koʻrsatgani: urugʻ bilan 15 tacha qush, non bilan 6 tadan ikki baravardan koʻp. «Only sunflower seeds» ortiqcha.
why.ru: Вывод — что показал подсчёт: около 15 птиц с семечками, больше чем вдвое против 6 с хлебом. «Only sunflower seeds» выходит за заметки.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The mahalla holds an autumn fair every October on the square by the school.
• Families sell vegetables, fruit and homemade pickles.
• Children perform songs and short plays on a small stage.
• Money from the fair pays for repairs to the mahalla playground.
• This year, the fair ran for two days instead of one.
• The best-selling stall sold pumpkin samsa.

The student wants to give an overview of the autumn fair.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Every October, the mahalla's autumn fair brings stalls of produce and pickles and shows by children, and its money pays for playground repairs.
This year, the mahalla's autumn fair on the square by the school ran for two days instead of one, and its best-selling stall sold pumpkin samsa.
The children performed songs and short plays on a small stage at the fair.
This year, the mahalla's autumn fair ran for two days instead of one.

why.en: An overview covers the whole fair: when, what happens and what the money is for. The other choices give only a detail or two.
why.uz: Umumiy koʻrinish butun yarmarkani qamrab oladi: qachon, nima boʻladi va pul nimaga ketadi. Boshqa javoblar faqat bir-ikki tafsilotni beradi.
why.ru: Обзор охватывает всю ярмарку: когда, что там бывает и на что идут деньги. Остальные варианты дают лишь одну-две детали.

instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Shoxrux wanted to know which of three kinds of soil kept water longest.
• He filled three cups with garden soil, sand and clay soil.
• He poured 100 milliliters of water into each cup.
• He weighed each cup every evening for five days.
• The clay soil lost water most slowly.
• He chose clay soil for his pepper seedlings, which need damp roots.

The student wants to describe the method Shoxrux used.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Shoxrux poured 100 milliliters of water into cups of garden soil, sand and clay soil, then weighed each cup every evening for five days.
Shoxrux chose clay soil for his pepper seedlings, which need damp roots, because of the three soils he tested it lost water most slowly.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The school canteen stopped selling fizzy drinks in September.
• It now sells water, milk and fruit tea instead.
• The head cook says sugary drinks made many pupils sleepy in afternoon lessons.
• Parents had also asked for healthier drinks at a school meeting.
• Sales of fruit tea have grown every month since.

The student wants to explain why the canteen stopped selling fizzy drinks.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The canteen stopped selling fizzy drinks because sugary drinks made pupils sleepy in the afternoon and parents had asked for healthier ones.
Since the canteen stopped selling fizzy drinks in September, sales of fruit tea have grown every month.
The canteen stopped selling fizzy drinks because they had become too expensive.
The canteen now sells water, milk and fruit tea in place of fizzy drinks.

why.en: The notes give two reasons, sleepy pupils and parents' wishes, and the key states them. 'Too expensive' is a reason the notes never give.
why.uz: Qaydlarda ikki sabab bor: uyquchan oʻquvchilar va ota-onalar istagi; toʻgʻri javob ikkalasini aytadi. «Too expensive» qaydlarda yoʻq.
why.ru: В заметках две причины: сонные ученики и просьба родителей; ключ называет обе. «Too expensive» — причина не из заметок.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Last spring, the pupils of Class 10B painted a large picture on the wall of the school canteen.
• The picture shows the mountains, a river and the town bazaar.
• Twelve pupils took part, led by their art teacher.
• The work took 26 afternoons, from March to May.
• They used 40 liters of paint.
• The head teacher unveiled it at the end of the school year.

The student wants to emphasize how much time the painting took.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Painting the picture on the canteen wall took Class 10B 26 afternoons, from March to May.
Last spring, twelve pupils of Class 10B, led by their art teacher, painted the mountains, a river and the bazaar on the canteen wall.
Class 10B used 40 liters of paint for the picture on the canteen wall.
At the end of the school year, the head teacher unveiled the picture painted by Class 10B.

why.en: The goal is one aspect, time: 26 afternoons from March to May. A full overview hides it, and 40 liters of paint is an amount, not a time.
why.uz: Maqsad bitta jihat — vaqt: martdan maygacha 26 kun tushdan keyin. Umumiy gap uni yashiradi, 40 litr boʻyoq esa vaqt emas.
why.ru: Цель — один аспект, время: 26 дней с марта по май. Полный обзор его скрывает, а 40 литров краски — это не время.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The school started sorting its rubbish in January.
• Each classroom has three bins: blue for paper, yellow for plastic, grey for everything else.
• At the end of the day, two pupils from each class carry the bins to the yard.
• There they empty them into three large containers of the same colors.
• A recycling truck collects the paper and plastic every Thursday.
• The school now throws away half as much rubbish as before.

The student wants to describe how the rubbish is sorted and collected.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Pupils sort rubbish into blue, yellow and grey bins in each classroom, empty them into matching containers in the yard, and a truck takes the paper and plastic on Thursdays.
Since the school started sorting its rubbish in January, it throws away half as much as before.
Each classroom has a blue bin for paper, a yellow bin for plastic and a grey bin for everything else, and since January the school has thrown away half as much rubbish as before.
The school sorts its rubbish so that the paper and the plastic can be recycled.

why.en: To describe the process, the answer follows the rubbish from classroom bins to yard containers to the Thursday truck. A list of bins is one step.
why.uz: Jarayonni tasvirlash uchun javob chiqindini sinf qutilaridan hovli konteynerlariga va payshanbadagi mashinagacha kuzatadi. Qutilar roʻyxati — faqat bitta qadam.
why.ru: Чтобы описать процесс, ответ ведёт мусор от классных урн к контейнерам во дворе и к машине по четвергам. Список урн — один шаг.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• In April, the pupils of a village school held a "no phones at lunch" week.
• For five days, everyone left their phones in a box at the canteen door.
• Before the week, a teacher counted how many pupils talked with someone during lunch: 40 of 120.
• On the last day of the week, she counted again: 95 of 120.
• Many pupils asked for the week to be repeated in May.

The student wants to present the result of the week.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: By the last day of the week, 95 of the 120 pupils talked with someone at lunch, up from 40 before it began.
For five days in April, pupils at the village school left their phones in a box at the canteen door during lunch.
Before the week began, a teacher counted 40 of the 120 pupils talking with someone at lunch.
The week without phones made the pupils of the village school happier and calmer.

why.en: A result is what changed: 95 of 120 talked at lunch by the last day, up from 40. 'Happier and calmer' is not in the notes.
why.uz: Natija — nima oʻzgargani: oxirgi kuni 120 tadan 95 tasi gaplashdi, oldin 40 ta edi. «Happier and calmer» qaydlarda yoʻq.
why.ru: Результат — что изменилось: к последнему дню за обедом говорили 95 из 120, а было 40. «Happier and calmer» нет в заметках.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Five stones is a game that Shirin learned from her grandmother.
• Players throw one small stone into the air.
• While it is in the air, they pick up other stones from the ground and then catch it.
• The player who picks up all the stones without a drop wins.
• Her grandmother played it as a girl.
• Shirin now plays it with her friends at break.

The student wants to introduce the game to readers who have never played it.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: In five stones, players toss one stone up, pick up others while it is in the air and catch it; whoever picks up all the stones without a drop wins.
Shirin learned to play five stones from her grandmother, who played it as a girl, and now she plays the game with her own friends during the break at school.
Shirin now plays five stones with her friends at break.
The player who picks up all the stones without dropping one wins the game.

why.en: Readers who have never played need what the game is and how it goes: toss, pick up, catch, and how to win. The others give one part or a story.
why.uz: Hech oʻynamaganlarga oʻyin qanday oʻtishi kerak: otish, terish, ushlash va qanday yutish. Qolganlari bitta qism yoki tarix.
why.ru: Тем, кто не играл, нужно, как идёт игра: бросить, подобрать, поймать и как выиграть. Остальное — одна часть или история.
